purpose: Targeted immutable A/B rerun of fixed-ledger order 79 after a reusable Writer reference-context and tool-routing fix.
change_scope: Expose compact marker and reference metadata derived from full Writer paragraphs before preview truncation, prefer those structured fields in LiteAgent context, clarify the generic numbered-reference schema, and disambiguate cross-reference from cross-out routing.

implementation_evidence.hypothesis: The v40 Adapter inspected full Writer paragraphs but returned only the first 500 characters of each. LiteAgent reconstructed marker metadata from those previews, so a valid placeholder after character 500 was invisible and Qwen guessed markers. A compact full-text-derived marker index plus an explicit reusable reference contract should make the existing generic operation discoverable without task identity, answer injection, or Runner-selected arguments.
implementation_evidence.counterfactual: Tests use an unrelated long paragraph containing <review later>, a different three-entry reference list, alternate markers such as <inspect later> and <verify section>, and unrelated citation text. They prove the 500-character preview stays bounded while structured markers remain visible, old Adapter responses retain fallback behavior, cross out still routes to paragraph formatting, and strict Runtime forwards model-selected numbered-reference arguments unchanged.
implementation_evidence.current_instruction_router_check: For the exact instruction, the strict seven-action list is document.inspect, document.save, document.add_numbered_reference, paragraph.set_format, document.add_page_numbers, document.deduplicate_records, and paragraph.apply_split_tabstop. task.execute is absent.
implementation_evidence.prior_runtime_attempt: experiments/generic-only-coverage-order79-v40-run1 is immutable: reward 0.0, 30 steps, no Agent termination, valid generic-only audit, and zero task/golden leakage or Runner argument rewrite/injection.
implementation_evidence.setup_cache_evidence: The UUID-prefixed setup source remains pristine at SHA-256 245f3064d64dead11e37b341ca5ab42e4435c6ac63ad0fe14c3f7513a37e249a. The evaluator result destination uses a separate non-prefixed cache filename and is not used by OSWorld setup reset.
implementation_evidence.legacy_route_boundary: writer_adapter/tasks.py remains only for explicit historical reproduction. Strict deployment removes installed copies and matching bytecode before the first model request; the public catalog and AdapterExecutor also reject task.execute.
implementation_evidence.osworld_evaluator_tree: frozen commit with zero tracked changes; an unrelated untracked .conda directory is ignored by the evaluator-tree audit
implementation_evidence.changed_source_leakage_scan: No current task UUID, source episode ID, source filename, citation answer, marker literal, golden value, or evaluator expected state was added to production code or new counterfactual tests.

selection.method: targeted rerun of the first non-pass in the task-ID-deduplicated development coverage ledger after a reusable fix
